title: Starting Date for Counting a Return-By Extension
content:
The days of a courtesy extension of a Returns & Exchanges return-by date are counted from a starting date. Where the starting date lies after the current return-by date, the days between them are added to the extension as well.

## Starting date

| Situation on the authorization | Counting |
|---|---|
| The current return-by date is earlier than the last day of the return window | Counted from the last day of the return window: the days from the current return-by date to that day are added |
| The current return-by date is the last day of the return window, and the order was delivered after its promised delivery date | The days the delivery came late (from the promised delivery date to the delivered date) are added |
| Any other case | Counted from the current return-by date: nothing is added |

**Last day of the return window:** the order's delivered date plus the return type's return window (the figure for non-footwear lines), plus the return window extension days of the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership in status active where the return type adds them. Dates are read from the Online Orders record of the order (delivered date, promised delivery date) and from the return (current return-by date).

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

- Delivered 1 March; 30-day window plus a Marlowe Rewards extension of 30 days, on a type that adds it: the last day of the window is 30 April. The return-by date is 1 April (set by label validity). The days from 1 April to 30 April, 29, are added.
- Promised 10 March, delivered 13 March; 30-day window, no Marlowe Rewards extension: the last day of the window is 12 April, which is also the return-by date. The delivery came 3 days late, so 3 days are added.
- Delivered on its promised date, return-by date equal to the last day of the window: nothing is added.
- A holiday delivery whose return-by date of 31 January lies after the last day of the window: nothing is added.
